Lina Q: Quick sync: final launch announcement goes live Wed 09:00 PT. Need engineering to confirm changelog URL + docs link by EOD so we can schedule the post.
Marco H: Changelog is at https://redwood.ai/changelog/v0.9.1 (draft). Main items: streaming improvements, prefix caching, Dedicated GA toggles.
Lina Q: Can you paste the exact promo blurb marketing will use so legal can review?
Marco H: Suggested blurb: 'Redwood Inference v0.9.1: reduced streaming latency and improved caching to speed up interactive apps. Dedicated capacity now generally available for reserved customers.'
Tessa R: Avoid using "generally available" until contracts signoff. Recommend "Dedicated capacity: ready for reserved customers" instead.
Marco H: Ok will tweak. Also note: some console screenshots behind feature flag until full rollout. Docs PR #512 will list that.
Dev Deploy Bot: Canary rollout scheduled: Tue 02:30 PT -> target: canary-us-west-2; smoke tests enabled; notify: #eng-oncall. Job id: 112233.
Noah S: For rollout timing: canaries Tue 02:30 PT, staged rollout Wed 03:00 PT, press embargo Wed 08:00 PT. Is that still the plan?
Lina Q: Yes. Marketing will post at 09:00 PT once docs/changelog links are live. Need one confirmed contact for rollback.
Marco H: I'll own rollback. Rollback playbook in runbook: https://redwood.ai/runbooks/release-rollback. Steps: revert to v0.9.0, run smoke, confirm metrics.
Tessa R: Webinar planned Thu 10am PT. Speakers: Marco (tech), Lina (product), Noah (customer ROI). We'll route leads to webhook https://hooks.redwood.ai/lead-v0-9 with utm_campaign=launch_v0_9_1.
Noah S: Demo accounts are ready in staging; SSO creds shared in 1Password. For lead routing, please include 'interest_area' and 'company_size' fields if possible.
Lina Q: Good call. Marketing will add those to the form. Also we'll tag all inbound as "launch_v0.9.1" in CRM.
Tessa R: One last thing: benchmark numbers in the draft are internal. Please label them "preliminary internal benchmarks" and link the bench: https://bench.redwood.ai/runs/1357.
Marco H: Done, I'll update the changelog to include that line.
Lina Q: Perfect. I'll update the announcement draft and post final copy by 4pm PT. If anyone can't deliver links by then, flag here ASAP.
Dev Deploy Bot: Reminder: canary pool will be drained for maintenance Tue 01:45 PT. Consider shifting canary if that conflicts.
Noah S: Moving canary to Tue 03:15 PT to avoid maintenance window. Updated in release doc.
Lina Q: Thanks team. Final checklist added to the launch doc. :white_check_mark:
